source.title: Some new results and open problems on oscillation of nonlinear difference equations

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver record. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/1732922 returned a blocked_or_challenged Cloudflare 403 response, and local API/OAI host fetches failed under the restricted sandbox. A previously captured local zbMATH shard identified the exact resolver metadata title and year but contained no DOI, arXiv, or full-text link.

Failure mode: metadata_only plus blocked_or_challenged resolver. Exact-work recovery attempted the zbMATH identifier 1732922, the exact title, title fragments with nonlinear difference equations, and title/topic/year searches. Candidate pages found in the bounded pass were unrelated modern articles, reference-list mentions, general contents pages, or pages that did not confirm the same exact title as a readable PDF or HTML source. No readable exact-work artifact containing the technical problem statements was recovered.
Source adequacy gate failed before mapping or extraction because only resolver metadata was available; no questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or related works.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/1732922.json and outputs/latest.json.
